descriptionMarkdown:
Hello everyone, I present to you my book of blueprints for the planet Fulgora. Here is everything you need for a comfortable passage of the game and the development of the factory

**How to use it?**

All blueprints are signed, almost all have a description, and an even more detailed description is in my profile. All blueprints are designed for the use of drones, so you just assemble the factory you need from blocks yourself. Somewhere you need to supply liquids, but all inputs and outputs will be signed
All blueprints in the book are fully functional and stable, but in the future it is planned to add many more interesting developments

**Contents of the blueprint book:**
1. Scrap recycler is the heart of the base on Fulgora, there are three versions, but I recommend using the last one - the most advanced. Name "Scrap recycling"
2. Production of EM plants, without quality
3. Powerful production of holmium plates - 10k plates per minute with a quality filter
4. All liquids: water, gas, acid and light oil
5. Rocket fuel
6. Refined concrete of all types of quality, will be useful for the production of quantum processors
7. Production of all types of quality modules of the third level
8. Combined production of supercapacitors and superconductors of all types of quality
9. Low-density structures and electric motors
10. Upgrade planners

What is planned in the future
1. Bring the drawings to perfection and add a description to each
2. Separate the production of supercapacitors and superconductors

All drawings will be updated exclusively inside the drawing book for now, perhaps in the future they will be updated or added to the profile
title: Fulgora blueprint book. All in
